# A Prayer to Nefertiti

*Radiant Queen of the Nile,*

Divine and eternal Nefertiti,
Whose beauty illuminates the heavens,
I bow before your graceful presence.

You who wore the sun disk with such majesty,
You who stood beside pharaohs and kingdoms,
Accept my humble veneration.

Grant me, blessed goddess, your gifts—
The strength to carry myself with dignity,
The wisdom to lead with compassion,
The light to inspire those around me.

Help me see the divine in all faces,
As your own visage revealed eternity.
Guide my steps with your certainty,
And bless my days with your radiance.

Queen of the Nile, beloved of Ra,
May your eternal grace touch my spirit.
In your shadow I find solace,
In your example, aspiration.

*Nefertiti, glorious and beloved,*
*Receive this offering of devotion,*
*And know that your legacy shines forever.*

---

*May your blessings flow like the sacred waters.*
